## Summary

What changed and why, in plain language.

## Linked issue / ADR

- Closes #NNN / relates to ADR-NNNN (if a design decision is touched, amend the ADR in this PR).

## Test plan

- [ ] Unit tests added or updated for changed behavior
- [ ] Integration tests where the change crosses a service boundary
- [ ] Manual verification — command run and expected output
- [ ] UI changes: screenshot attached

## Checklist

- [ ] Commit messages follow Conventional Commits
- [ ] No secrets in the diff (`.env`, `*.pem`, `*.key`, `*.crt`)
- [ ] Documentation updated for any user-visible change
- [ ] CI green
